title: What makes attending the Mahotsav a rare and sacred opportunity?

segments.text: Special Blessings & Rare Darshan of Dadi Ji ​Blessings of the Mantra Guru (Dadi Ji): The Mahotsav offers a sacred and golden opportunity to receive the personal blessings of Parikshit Bhaiya’s Mantra Guru, lovingly addressed by everyone as Dadi Ji (as Parikshit Bhaiya calls her). ​An Elevated Soul & Powerhouse: Dadi Ji is a highly revered spiritual soul who has spent decades in intense naam-jaap (mantra chanting). Parikshit Bhaiya often compares himself to a thin live wire, while reverently describing Dadi Ji as the power house or transformer—the original, limitless source from which all the energy and grace flows. ​A Rare Occurrence: Dadi Ji visits the ashram only twice a year—first on Guru Purnima, and second during the annual Mahotsav. ​Personal Interaction: On her designated visit day during the Mahotsav, she personally meets, interacts with, and blesses all visiting devotees and guests, making it an extraordinarily rare spiritual experience to be in her presence.
